exposure: Metabolic profile of maternal blood serum
cohort: The study included 35 pregnant women who delivered preterm and 35 pregnant women who delivered at term, from whom amniotic fluid and maternal blood serum samples were prospectively collected during the second trimester of gestation.
finding: The metabolic content of second-trimester amniotic fluid and maternal blood serum showed differentiations in key metabolites between women who delivered preterm and those who delivered at term, indicating potential for identifying biomarkers for preterm delivery.
gest_age: Second trimester (for sample collection); 29 weeks + 0 days to 36 weeks + 5 days gestation (for preterm delivery group)
